description: WP-12A machine-readable acceptance contract. The WP-12B review-artifact validator consumes this file as its structural source of truth. The BINDING facts a review must reconcile against — the real PR head SHA, the final commit's committed-at, the canonical ratified criterion set, and the set of gates that must pass — are NOT taken from the review artifact; they are supplied to the validator as TrustedInputs sourced externally (git/GitHub for SHAs+timestamps; the owner-ratified acceptance manifest for criteria+gates). Editing this file changes the success bar for merges; it is a protected surface (see protected-surface.txt) and may only change under owner review. See specs/SPEC_WP12_assurance_kernel.md.
note_on_independent_review: The review of record is the typed JSON payload in the trusted reviewer's GitHub review BODY (pure JSON or a ```json fenced block) — NOT a file committed to the branch (that was self-referential: a committed artifact must name the SHA of the commit that contains it). An APPROVE is believed ONLY when GitHub's review API shows a review whose actor == trusted_independent_reviewer, state == APPROVED, is not dismissed, targets the EXACT live head SHA (commit_id == pr_head_sha), whose actor != the PR author, and whose body payload reconciles (reviewed_sha == pr_head_sha == the live head). COMMENTED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, DISMISSED, a wrong actor, a missing review, an unparseable body, or an approval left on a previous (stale) SHA all fail closed. A synchronize/push moves the head, so a prior approval's commit_id no longer matches — the new head must be independently RE-approved. This custom gate does NOT count as, or replace, GitHub-native branch-protection approval (that remains a separate WP-12E owner requirement).
note_on_nits: Interim, per-slice dispositions such as 'APPROVE-WITH-NITS' or 'LAND-WITH-NITS' are NOT valid final merge verdicts. A slice that leaves any ratified acceptance criterion unmet is CHANGES-REQUIRED, regardless of how small the residual looks. This is the exact PRIV-001 escaped-defect class (ESC-2026-08-13-priv001-spec-conformance).
note_on_trust: reviewed_sha / pr_head_sha / final_commit_committed_at / the criterion set / gate results / reviewer in the artifact are SELF-ATTESTED and are only believed insofar as they equal TrustedInputs. An APPROVE that cannot be reconciled against TrustedInputs fails closed (UNVERIFIABLE_APPROVE). A 40-hex lowercase SHA format is required; short or non-hex SHAs are rejected.
note_on_external_binding: Gate results come from REAL check conclusions (GitHub check-runs / same-workflow needs.*.result), not the payload's gates[].status — a self-declared 'pass' that contradicts the real conclusion is rejected (GATE_CONCLUSION_MISMATCH), and an APPROVE requires every required gate to have a real 'success'. Reviewer identity + review state + commit_id come from GitHub's review API (gh api repos/<repo>/pulls/<n>/reviews) and the PR author from gh; none are read from the payload. Because the review of record is the bot's review BODY (not a branch commit), the reviewed SHA is the review's commit_id (== the live head) and the payload's reviewed_sha is checked directly against the live head — there is no evidence-commit parent and no self-reference.
